name: PROD: Restart of Same Course After Withdrawal, Same Provider — Baseline Behavior (No Dedicated Flag, Detection Not Built)
description: PROD baseline — Restart (FLP-1806) has no dedicated feature flag and full Restart detection (adding a second episode) does not exist yet (see upcoming/restarts.md). UpdateShortCourseCommandHandler.HandleSingleItem now has a deliberate short-circuit: when the matched episode for the requested UKPRN IsTerminal (approved AND (withdrawn or completed)), the restart PUT is ignored as if it were not in the incoming payload at all — no fields are overwritten, no second episode is created, and the call returns IsIgnored=true. ZSC00001 is POSTed and approved, then withdrawn via PUT (terminal episode). SLD then re-submits the same course/provider with a new start date after the withdrawal, simulating a restart attempt, via PUT against the existing learnerKey. This was confirmed as a genuine baseline risk before the short-circuit was added: the restart PUT used to fall through to learning.Update() and silently overwrite the withdrawn episode's StartDate/WithdrawalDate in place. The assertions below confirm the short-circuit holds: 1 episode, with its original StartDate and WithdrawalDate both untouched by the restart attempt.

steps.name: SLD Withdraws the Learner via PUT (terminal episode)
SLD Re-PUTs the same course/provider with a new start date after withdrawal (restart attempt)

assertions.name: Still exactly 1 ShortCourseEpisode row for ZSC00001/Provider A (restart attempt did not create a second episode)
Episode untouched by the restart PUT — silently ignored (short-circuit)
